title: Mnemosyne: Agentic Transaction Processing for Validating and Repairing AI-generated Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2607.00269v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLMs increasingly generate workflow actions and repairs that may be well formed yet stale, infeasible, conflicting, or destructive of their own evidence. We introduce Agentic Transaction Processing (ATP), which treats generated actions as untrusted proposals until deterministic admission accepts them under an executable constraint set C. Its two-sided principle is: a proposal is not truth, and no proposal foresees every disruption. Anything may propose, but only the runtime admits and commits; unforeseen disruptions trigger bounded reactive repair whose output re-enters admission. Mnemosyne realizes ATP with an append-only transition log, effective-state projection, dependency-safe compensation, and active contract records. translated_title: Mnemosyne：用于验证与修复AI生成工作流的代理式事务处理
translated_abstract: LLM 越来越多地生成工作流动作与修复方案，这些动作和修复虽然格式良好，却可能过时、不可行、相互冲突，甚至破坏其自身的证据。我们提出了代理式事务处理（Agentic Transaction Processing, ATP），它将生成的动作视为不可信的提案，直到确定性准入机制在可执行约束集 C 下接受它们为止。其双向原则是：提案不是真理，且没有任何提案能预见所有干扰。任何主体都可以提出提案，但只有运行时才能准入并提交；未预见的干扰会触发有界的反应式修复，其输出会重新进入准入流程。Mnemosyne 通过仅追加的转换日志、有效状态投影、依赖安全的补偿机制以及活跃契约记录来实现 ATP。在给定假设下并相对于约束集 C，我们证明了四个安全性属性（权限分离、串行等价的生成式准入、保持证据的修复以及义务包含），并建立了有界……
tldr: 该论文提出代理式事务处理（ATP）框架 Mnemosyne，将 LLM 生成的动作与修复视为不可信提案，通过确定性准入机制、仅追加转换日志和依赖安全补偿来验证与修复 AI 生成的工作流，并证明了四个关键安全性属性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Agentic Transaction Processing (ATP) realized by the Mnemosyne system, which treats LLM-generated actions and repairs as untrusted proposals admitted deterministically under executable constraints, using an append-only transition log and dependency-safe compensation to validate and repair AI-generated workflows with four proven safety properties.
